title: Why Reading/Watching Record of Ragnarok will make you transcend Godhood
summary: Scripted recommendation of the manga Record of Ragnarok, in which human champions fight gods. NH draws motivation from three humans: Lu Bu's love of combat, Adam's refusal to accept fate, and Sasaki Kojiro's endless training despite defeat. He recommends the manga over the weak Netflix anime.
claims: Read the Record of Ragnarok manga rather than watch the Netflix anime, which ranges from mediocre to terrible and skips key moments
The anime draws the characters even more muscular, which makes the human fighters' physiques look unattainable
Lu Bu kept training brutally even after he was already the strongest man alive, which makes him a training role model
The all-out final clash between Thor and Lu Bu captures the intensity of a set of deadlifts taken to failure
Adam fights for his children and refuses the fate written for him; that indomitable spirit inspires anyone trying to improve
Lifting is more than picking things up: to keep progressing you must develop your reasoning, much of it through philosophy
Sasaki Kojiro, beaten many times but never stopping, is the patron saint of people who must work twice as hard for results; aim for slow incremental progress
Whatever the task, the winner is whoever sticks with it the longest
Struggle either breaks you or tempers you into tougher steel
